limitations: Summaries are exported from preserved local run artifacts; private operational databases, full message logs, credentials and model weights are not distributed.
Source defaults for output and lock paths were made repository-relative for publication after the measurements; historical snapshots and measurements were not rerun or rewritten.
TSR normalization only repairs two registered JSON-format defects, without changing semantic verdicts. The 1 budget-interrupted task remains in the denominator.
Retrieval is a seen Cloud-only subset. The additional gain over previous rerank is 0.8759 percentage points and its 95% interval includes zero.
